revisions.feedback: The first draft is pretty basic.
revisions.decision: Replace the static marketing screenshot and title-card rhythm with real Croki interaction footage, spatial product-state transitions, and product-led motion. Keep typography secondary and keep Canvas domain-agnostic.

revisions.feedback: The review video does not seem to play.
revisions.decision: Add standards-compliant byte-range and HEAD responses to the local review server, restart it, and verify in Croki Preview that the video reaches readyState 4 and advances during playback.

revisions.feedback: Everything is ugly and hard to read. LottieLab was not actively used.
revisions.decision: Reject the existing visual cut. Rebuild with one legible idea per shot, crisp repository-rendered product fragments, and a real versioned LottieLab handoff rendered through Remotion. Do not enlarge blurry full-app recordings into hero visuals.
